labels.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE concentration-time inputs for rat systemic PK consist of source-table group summaries at three times for each dose group and study day. The source explicitly establishes destructive sampling rather than individual trajectories. DR003, DR004, DR008, DR010 and MC001 remain partially supported and UNRESOLVED: concentration-table units, total/unbound basis, IV input type, dose formulation basis and several animal characteristics are unspecified. Group I Day 1 includes NC; Group I Day 92 includes a mean containing substituted detection-limit values. Reported SE describes group-summary uncertainty and does not establish individual PK variability. DR006 is supported for rat systemic PK; no survival or bacterial-burden endpoint occurs here. No model, parameter or translation eligibility is established.

findings.reason: F0003:S3:T1 supplies concentration body values and Mean ± SE, but no explicit unit for the concentration columns. The µg/ml units in A4 and A5 explicitly qualify detection limits; their applicability to all concentration-table values is not stated.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed confirmation of the concentration-column units before unit-dependent preparation or analysis; preserve the two detection-limit statements separately.

findings.reason: A1 and A3 identify plasma meropenem, unlabeled dosing, IV administration and a daily 92-day regimen. Bolus versus infusion, input duration, salt/free-base dose basis, total/unbound concentration basis and animal health, infection, immune, renal and pregnancy states are NOT_FOUND. IV alone does not support either fixed IV route category.
findings.needed_material: Source-backed metadata for these distinctions, or explicit retention of each unknown; do not assume healthy animals, bolus input, steady state or a dose-basis conversion.

findings.reason: B9 is NC, defined in A4 as not calculated with 4/6 non-detectable values and a 1.12 µg/ml detection limit. C9 is 0.56***±0.09; A5 states that 0.36 µg/ml was substituted for each of 2/6 ND values. These are distinct source contexts, not interchangeable missing values or limits.
findings.needed_material: Retain NC unchanged, flag C9 as a mean containing substituted detection-limit values, preserve SE and significance markers, and confirm these mappings during independent review.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE inputs are group means with SE at 10, 20 and 50 min on days 1 and 92 for three dose groups. A3 explicitly identifies terminal sampling of different subgroups. Predose, administration-time and other boundary observations, actual-versus-nominal time definitions, individual records and detailed IV input history are not supplied. DR008 component eligibility and design support remain unassessed; this page provides systemic plasma evidence, without pulmonary or CSF measurements.
findings.needed_material: Animal PK assessment of the available design and summary-only limitations, with source-backed missing metadata where available. Retain component eligibility, identifiability and prediction questions for that module without selecting or testing a model here.

findings.reason: Carry unchanged: field Support for individual PK variability; status DEFERRED; needed_at pk; resolution_status OPEN; origin main:/missing_information/items/7. Population variability for later simulation cannot be represented as empirically supported until its basis is assessed. This page establishes terminal group-summary sampling and Mean ± SE of 6 rats, rather than verified individual PK trajectories or reported population variability parameters. The page assessment does not close MI008.
findings.needed_material: Assess the available experimental units and variability evidence during PK work; distinguish supported variability from uncertainty and retain any limitation for PTA. Under DR010, record the evidence-based outcome at PK assessment; do not derive empirical interindividual variability from these group means or SE values.

findings.reason: This page supplies rat concentration summaries, source provenance and study/regimen context. It supplies neither a parameter-by-species inventory nor actual study body weights or reported CL/Vss estimates. Health-state and normalization comparability remain unresolved. No cross-species parameter-coverage match or species qualification is established.
findings.needed_material: Reuse the later per-species parameter inventory and obtain actual study weights if body-size scaling is considered; retain unresolved parameter definitions, health-state comparability and review status before translation.

findings.reason: Concentration summaries and daily IV dose groups are available, but no selected clearance endpoint, reported clearance estimate, AUC window, verified steady state or matched dosing interval is stated. Observations extend only to 50 min on this page. Whether the available course supports a selected clearance objective requires downstream assessment; neither sufficiency nor insufficiency is established here.
findings.needed_material: If clearance is selected, define its parameter and intended use, resolve dose and concentration bases and IV input history, and assess the available exposure-course coverage in the PK module.

findings.reason: Measured group-summary concentrations, times, counts and SE are available, with explicit censoring and substitution qualifications. A requested finite-window AUC, intended index use, total/free basis, window boundaries, actual-versus-nominal timing, variance/covariance and assay/stability context are not supplied. The observed 10–50 min sampling range does not define an approved AUC window.
findings.needed_material: If measured observations are selected for index exposure derivation, obtain the proposal-defined endpoint and window, resolve relevant units and metadata, and retain missing uncertainty inputs separately from point-estimate inputs. Do not choose an integration or boundary method here.
